title: ApplicationFunction
description: TOGAF-sourced mechanism archetype — Application Architecture behavioral unit. An application function is the automated behavior that an Application Component (Structure) performs. Extends Mechanism with TOGAF Application Architecture vocabulary. Source framework: TOGAF (Content Metamodel → Application Function).

functionType.description: Application function behavioral classification. QUERY = read/retrieve, COMMAND = state-changing action, TRANSFORMATION = data conversion/enrichment, VALIDATION = constraint checking, ORCHESTRATION = multi-step coordination. TOGAF mapping: Application Function behavioral type.

idempotent.description: Whether repeated invocations produce the same effect. Governs retry strategy and error recovery design.
